core_obligations: (1) implies (2): an unramified morphism is DM, and unramifiedness is preserved by base change, so the test in (2) holds (proof lines 8354-8357)
(2) implies (3): choose a scheme covering the target and, using that the morphism is DM, an etale scheme covering the fibre product; the composite is unramified (proof lines 8358-8366)
(3) implies DM-ness: check that the base change along the given cover is DM by applying the covering criterion and the DM criterion to the covering space (proof lines 8367-8382)

(2) plus DM-ness implies (1): after base changing along the cover one reduces to the case where the target is an algebraic space, and there the equivalence between unramifiedness of the morphism and of its etale presentation, together with the descent statement for unramifiedness, gives the conclusion (proof lines 8383-8401)
proof_roadmap: (1)⇒(2)：unramified ⇒ DM，且 unramified 保持基变换。
(2)⇒(3)：由 DM 取目标概型与纤维积的 étale 概型覆盖，复合 unramified。
(3)⇒DM：沿给定覆盖用「覆盖检验」与 DM 判据。
(2)+DM⇒(1)：沿覆盖基变换后化为目标为代数空间的情形，那里 «unramified ⟺ 展示态射 unramified»，再由 unramified 的下降引理收尾。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives three equivalent characterizations of an unramified morphism of algebraic stacks, one of them reading the property off an etale presentation over a flat finitely presented cover of the base (author lemma at source lines 8337-8352, label lemma-unramified). The proof (source lines 8354-8402) runs the implications, constructing etale presentations from the DM characterization, checking DM-ness along the cover and, in the last step, reducing to a target that is an algebraic space where unramifiedness of the morphism is equivalent to that of its presentation, with the descent statement closing the argument (proof lines 8354-8401). The construction of the presentations and the final reduction are the substance. H3.
